ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 30:70 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, irregularly shaped white mottled patches are localized on the distal thirds of both the left and right lobes. The central region surrounding the peduncle and the medial portions of the lobes are composed of solid low-intensity black pixels. The right lobe white patch contains high-frequency dark speckling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow U-shaped depression centered between the lobes with a vertex angle approximately measured at 35-45 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations (jagged peaks and valleys) are visible along the continuous boundary of the trailing edge, particularly prominent on the inner half of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve following the trailing edge from the distal tips to the median notch; the overall lobe orientation shows an upward sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast dark pixels are embedded within the white patch of the right lobe; distinctive clusters of raised, high-intensity anomalies are present at the extreme tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced protrusions and irregular texture (consistent with barnacle colonization) at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, with a more vertical protrusion on the right tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'salt-and-pepper' mottling pattern localized within the distal white region of the right fluke lobe.
